exam_scheme.note: JIPMER Puducherry conducts selection for Nursing Officer and allied technical cadres through a two-stage process comprising an online Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by a Skill Test. The CBT carries 100 multiple-choice questions of 400 marks with a duration of 90 minutes. Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct response and negative marking of 1 mark for each incorrect response. Subject-specific Nursing syllabus comprises 70 questions (280 marks), and General Knowledge, General Intelligence, General English, and General Mathematics comprise 30 questions (120 marks). Minimum qualifying mark in CBT: 50% for UR/EWS, 40% for SC/ST/OBC. Candidates shortlisted in 1:3 ratio appear for the qualifying Skill Test.

financial_package.note: Nursing Officers at JIPMER Puducherry are compensated under Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix at Level 7 (entry basic ₹44,900) along with Nursing Allowance (₹7,200/month) and Uniform Allowance (₹1,800/month).
